st.consoleShell.theStaffConsoleIsFor: The staff console is for AfroTransact staff accounts. Shoppers and sellers use the shop and Seller Central.
st.consoleShell.slowTitle: This is taking longer than usual
st.consoleShell.slowBody: AfroTransact isn’t answering right now. Try again, or sign out and come back later.
st.consoleShell.loopBody: We stopped after being sent to {destination} {count} times in {seconds} seconds. Try again, or sign out and sign in again.
st.states.youDonTHaveAccess: You don’t have access to this page
st.chartCard.thisChartAppearsOnceIts: This chart appears once its data source is available.
st.notFound.thatPageIsnTPart: That page isn’t part of the staff console.
st.states.unavailable: This part of AfroTransact is temporarily unavailable
st.states.forbidden: You don’t have access to this
st.states.noAccessRoles: Your roles ({roles}) can’t open it. Ask an administrator if you need access.
st.resourceTable.queued: Large export queued — it builds in the background. Find it under Exports.
st.meta.title: Staff console
st.meta.description: The AfroTransact platform back office for staff.
st.form.errorSummary: {n, plural, one {There is # problem with this form} other {There are # problems with this form}}
st.delivery.title: AfroTransact Delivery pricing
st.delivery.intro: AfroTransact Delivery from the seller’s store: the seller packs, the nearest AfroTransact driver collects and delivers. The customer pays the delivery charge; the seller pays the seller delivery fee, deducted from the payout.
st.delivery.include: Change AfroTransact Delivery pricing in this version
st.delivery.carriedOver: Left unticked, v{v}’s delivery pricing carries over unchanged.
st.delivery.noneYet: No version prices AfroTransact Delivery yet: left unticked, it stays not offered.
st.delivery.notChanged: The delivery pricing of v{v} carries over: payments copies it when a version leaves the section out.
st.delivery.notConfigured: No delivery pricing: AfroTransact Delivery from sellers’ stores is not offered (quotes answer NOT_CONFIGURED).
st.delivery.enabled: Offer AfroTransact Delivery from sellers’ stores
st.delivery.enabledHelp: Off: shoppers can’t choose it under this version.
st.delivery.radiusHelp: Road distance from the store; beyond it the offer can’t be delivered to that address. More than 0, up to {max}.
st.delivery.flatHelp: Multiplied by the number of packages.
st.delivery.distanceHelp: A band covering the distance sets the fee; otherwise base + per-mile × miles (rounded half up), then raised to the minimum and capped at the maximum. Packages don’t count.
st.delivery.overridesHelp: A negotiated seller delivery fee for one organisation. {retail} never pays a delivery fee.
st.delivery.noOverrides: No overrides: every seller pays the seller delivery fee above.
st.delivery.removeOverride: Remove the delivery fee override for {seller}
st.delivery.findSeller: Find a seller for a delivery fee override
st.delivery.hasOverride: already has a delivery fee override
st.delivery.err.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, e.g. 4.99
st.delivery.err.miles: Enter miles with up to two decimals, e.g. 7.5
st.delivery.err.radius: Enter the maximum radius in miles, e.g. 25
st.delivery.quote.title: Quote preview
st.delivery.quote.seller.label: Seller
st.delivery.quote.beyond: Beyond the radius: not deliverable to that address
st.delivery.current: AfroTransact Delivery: {customer} for the customer, {seller} for the seller, within {miles} mi
st.delivery.currentOff: AfroTransact Delivery from stores: not offered
st.pickups.intro: AfroTransact Delivery from the seller’s store: the seller packs and the nearest available driver collects. New pickups join the best driver’s route automatically; here you see the ones still waiting and can override with a reason.
st.pickups.waitingTable: Seller pickups waiting for a route
st.pickups.none: No seller pickups are waiting: every pickup is on a driver’s route.
st.pickups.lookup: Open a pickup by shipment id
st.pickups.lookupHelp: Routed pickups are not in the pool; open them here.
st.pickups.assignForm: Assign the pickup to a route
st.pickups.reason: Reason (required, kept in the assignment log)
st.pickups.reasonHelp: 5 to 500 characters, e.g. “Closer driver’s van is full”.
st.pickups.viewOnly: Read-only: assigning needs delivery:dispatch and edit access to dispatch.
st.pickups.noDriversHelp: No driver in the pickup’s zone has a fresh position, a passed inspection and room. The zone route builder will place it.
st.pickups.err.reason: Say why you assign this route (5 to 500 characters)
st.ntf.source.sample: fixed sample, no event sends this yet
st.ntf.list.intro: Every message AfroTransact sends by email, SMS, push or WhatsApp. A new version takes over every later send of its key, locale and channel.
st.ntf.detail.noEvent: No event sends this template yet; producers request it with notification.requested.
st.ntf.detail.renderFailed: This version does not render with this data
st.ntf.detail.sampleHelp: Prefilled with the fields the event carries in production. Edits only change this preview.
st.ntf.detail.badJson: Not valid JSON; the preview keeps the last valid data.
st.ntf.preview.subject: Subject:
st.ntf.sms.segments: {n, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}} · {per} per segment
st.ntf.sms.gsmHelp: Every character is in the GSM 03.38 alphabet: 160 per segment, 153 per part when longer.
st.ntf.sms.ucs2Help: A character outside the GSM 03.38 alphabet (such as · or –) switches the message to UCS-2: 70 per segment, 67 per part.
st.ntf.history.title: Version history
st.ntf.history.subject: Subject
st.ntf.edit.title: Version {version} · {channel} · {locale}
st.ntf.edit.categoryHelp: Decides consent: security always sends, marketing needs opt-in.
st.ntf.edit.dataError: The sample data does not fit this template
st.ntf.edit.tooLongHelp: Shorten the message, or avoid characters outside the GSM alphabet (such as ·, – or emoji) that halve each segment.
st.ntf.edit.livePreviewHelp: Rendered by the notifications service with the sample data as you type.
st.ntf.field.subject: Subject
st.ntf.field.title: Title
st.ntf.field.htmlHelp: Go html/template: {{.field}} placeholders, {{if .field}}…{{end}} for optional rows. Values are escaped.
st.ntf.field.textHelp: Go text/template placeholders such as {{.firstName}}; every one must be a field of the sample data.
st.ntf.test.noPush: Push notifications can't be test-sent; use the preview.
st.ntf.edit.previewBlocked: The preview comes back as soon as the template renders: fix the fields marked in red.
st.plans.planFee.EARNINGS_FIRST: From sales first, card for the rest
st.plans.planFee.appliesFrom: A change applies from the invoice of {date}
st.plans.planFee.overrideHelp: Applies from the seller’s next invoice and is recorded with your reason. The seller sees it in Plan & billing.
st.plans.planFee.saved: Saved: applies from the seller’s next invoice
st.plans.planFee.offPlatform: Paying plans from sales is switched off on this platform: every plan invoice is charged to the card.
st.plans.noCollections: No invoices paid from earnings yet.
st.plans.settings.title: Paying plans from sales
st.plans.settings.on: On: sellers may pay their plan from their sales
st.plans.settings.off: Off: every plan invoice is charged to the card
st.plans.settings.killSwitchHelp: Set per environment by operations; it can’t be changed here.
st.plans.settings.defaultHelp: Applies to sellers who don’t choose on the onboarding Plan step. Existing sellers keep their choice.
st.plans.badAmount: Enter amounts in dollars, like 39 or 39.50.
st.plans.badDays: Enter a whole number of days.
st.plans.campaignHelp: A campaign applies by promo code (entered on the onboarding Plan step) or by sign-up window. The longest matching trial wins.
st.plans.codeHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and _, e.g. seller_plus
st.plans.findOrgPlaceholder: Seller or provider name, or org id
st.plans.migrateHelp: Each subscription moves to the current version’s price at its next renewal; nothing is prorated.
st.plans.name: Name
st.plans.nobodyToMigrate: Nobody is on an older version.
st.plans.pickOrg: Find an organisation to see its plan, invoices and rewards, and to make adjustments.
st.plans.pricesHelp: Saves a draft version; publishing makes it current for new subscribers. Existing subscribers keep their version until you migrate them.
st.plans.recordedRetry: Recorded: {summary}. It will be applied shortly.
st.plans.ruleHelp: Reach the threshold (in the window, or within N days of approval) and get the reward, once per seller. Rules are checked on every order or booking event and daily.
st.plans.withinDaysOfStart: First N days of the subscription
st.plans.checkAtWindowEnd: Decide once, when the window closes
st.plans.checkLeadHours: Check (hours before the window or trial ends)
st.plans.windowEndHelp: Checked once, {hours} h before the window closes — or before the trial ends when it ends first — so free days move the first invoice before it is issued. Sales recorded after the check are not counted.
st.plans.s.metric.DAYS_SINCE_APPROVAL: who have been on AfroTransact for {cmp} {amount} days
st.plans.s.window.APPROVAL: in the first {days} days after approval
st.plans.s.window.SUBSCRIPTION_START: in the first {days} days of their subscription
st.plans.previewPending: {pending} still in their window (decided when it closes)
st.plans.adjustHelp.credit: Platform credit: the next invoices use it before sales or the card.
st.plans.adjustHelp.freeDays: Moves the next charge N days later, with no proration.
st.plans.adjustHelp.trial: Sets the trial to end N days after it started, even if shorter.
st.plans.adjustHelp.waive: Forgives the open invoice: no more retries, nothing owed.
st.rates.commissionHelp: Sellers pay this percentage of each sale on top of their plan fee.
st.rates.connectionHelp: Providers pay this percentage of each booking's service amount on top of their plan fee.
st.rates.plansUnavailable: The plan catalogue could not be read; plan columns show the rates the schedule already holds.
st.rates.connectionMatrix: Connection fees by service category and plan
st.rates.precedence: First match wins: an active negotiated rate (its category, then all categories), the plan's rate (category, then other categories), the category rate, the default. AfroTransact Retail pays none. Placed orders and bookings keep the rate they were placed with.
st.rates.noBase: There is no fee schedule to start from.
st.rates.endHelp: {org} pays its plan, category or default rate on orders and bookings from now on. Orders already placed keep their rate.
st.rates.endReason: Why it ends (kept in the audit trail)
st.rates.negotiateHelp: A commission or connection fee for one organisation that wins over its plan and category rates while active. The reason is required and audited.
st.rates.badRate: Enter a percentage with up to two decimals, e.g. 6.50
st.rates.calculatorHelp: What one organisation pays now on a product or service category, and why.
st.rates.planHelp: Creates a private, invite-only copy of a plan at the negotiated price, offered to this organisation only. The seller then chooses it in Plan & billing.
st.rates.pickPlan: Choose the plan to start from
st.rates.badPrice: Enter an amount in dollars, e.g. 29.00
st.plans.adjustHelp.freeMonths: Moves the next charge N calendar months later, with no proration.
st.plans.adjustHelp.chargeGate: A condition on the plan charges. Start after: free until the seller reaches it. Waive while: free while they keep it. Waive until: free until a date. Replaces any earlier condition.
st.plans.adjustHelp.clearGate: Removes the condition: the plan is charged as normal from the next invoice.
st.plans.badMonths: Enter a whole number of months (1–36).
st.plans.gate.mode.START_AFTER: Start charging after the seller reaches…
st.plans.gate.mode.WAIVE_WHILE: Free while the seller keeps at least…
st.plans.gate.badUntil: Choose the date the free stretch ends.
st.plans.allowsHelp: Only live listings are capped; there is no limit on shops or users. The seller service enforces these.
st.plans.badListings: Enter the most live listings, or tick Unlimited.
